panels.description: Failed or stale polls, device faults, filter soiled or due within 7 days, RTC battery under 2.7 V, frost protection.

targets.expr:
label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_up{device=~"$device"}) == 0, "issue", "last poll failed", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (time() - breezy_last_poll_timestamp{device=~"$device"}) > 300, "issue", "no poll for 5m+", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_fault_level{device=~"$device"}) == 1, "issue", "fault: alarm", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_fault_level{device=~"$device"}) == 2, "issue", "fault: warning", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_filter_status{device=~"$device"}) == 1, "issue", "filter soiled — replace", "", "")
or label_replace((max by (device) (breezy_filter_remaining_seconds{device=~"$device"}) < 7*86400 > 0) unless on (device) (max by (device) (breezy_filter_status{device=~"$device"}) == 1), "issue", "filter due within a week", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_rtc_battery_volts{device=~"$device"}) < 2.7, "issue", "clock battery low", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_frost_protection_active{device=~"$device"}) == 1, "issue", "frost protection active", "", "")

absent(
label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_up{device=~"$device"}) == 0, "issue", "last poll failed", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (time() - breezy_last_poll_timestamp{device=~"$device"}) > 300, "issue", "no poll for 5m+", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_fault_level{device=~"$device"}) == 1, "issue", "fault: alarm", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_fault_level{device=~"$device"}) == 2, "issue", "fault: warning", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_filter_status{device=~"$device"}) == 1, "issue", "filter soiled — replace", "", "")
or label_replace((max by (device) (breezy_filter_remaining_seconds{device=~"$device"}) < 7*86400 > 0) unless on (device) (max by (device) (breezy_filter_status{device=~"$device"}) == 1), "issue", "filter due within a week", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_rtc_battery_volts{device=~"$device"}) < 2.7, "issue", "clock battery low", "", "")
or label_replace(max by (device) (breezy_frost_protection_active{device=~"$device"}) == 1, "issue", "frost protection active", "", "")
)

panels.description: Off, airflow mode, or what has taken over: night/turbo timer, or an override (sensor over threshold, frost protection).

targets.expr:
max by (device) (
    (max by (device) (breezy_power{device=~"$device"}) == 0) * 0
  or (max by (device) (breezy_special_mode{device=~"$device"}) == 2) * 0 + 12
  or (max by (device) (breezy_special_mode{device=~"$device"}) == 1) * 0 + 11
  or (max by (device) (breezy_in_user_control{device=~"$device"}) == 0) * 0 + 10
  or max by (device) (breezy_airflow_mode{device=~"$device"}) + 1
)
